links.outcome: Sleep staging accuracy, kappa and weighted F1 before versus after applying energy-score uncertainty threshold for selective prediction
links.effect: MESA accuracy rose from 84.2% to 84.8-86.1%; CFS from 80.6% to 81.9-85.6%; CAP from 80.6% to 81.4-84.3%. Kappa and weighted F1 also improved.
links.quote: We observed a significant improvement in the model's performance with the implementation of the energy score threshold.

unlisted_practices: Local attention module for interpretability of which PPG epochs drive sleep-stage predictions

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of an uncertainty estimation threshold (energy score thresholding for selective prediction/rejection) on classification accuracy across three sleep datasets.
